title: Credit Control / Accounts Assistant
description:
Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant

Overview

Our client is a well known Sheffield-based manufacturing business with a long, proud history.

We are recruiting for Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant to join their Sheffield team on site. The role combines customer credit control with day-to-day accounts work, supporting invoicing, payment allocation and month-end tasks. You will work closely with the finance team to maintain accurate accounts, reduce overdue debt and ensure timely reconciliation.

Key responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and proactively chase overdue invoices to reduce days sales outstanding.
- Prepare and issue invoices, credit notes and customer statements accurately and promptly.
- Allocate customer receipts and reconcile bank transactions and ledgers.
- Support month-end close with account reconciliations and assisting with journal entries.
- Maintain accurate credit records, assess customer credit risk and raise queries where needed.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in credit control and general accounts administration.
- Excellent numeracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident use of accounting software and spreadsheets.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills with customers and internal teams.
- AAT or equivalent accounting qualification desirable or working towards one.

Package and benefits
- £28k to £30k (negotiable)
- Study support for accountancy qualifications

Next step
- Submit CV to the Shillito Group consultant for initial review.
- Telephone screening with the recruiter to discuss suitability and availability.
- Interview.

title: Purchase Ledger Administrator
description:
I am currently recruiting on behalf of a well-established and successful manufacturing business based in Doncaster for a Junior Purchase Ledger Administrator to join their finance team.

We have worked closely with this business for many years, and they are a fantastic organisation to work with. They have an excellent reputation, low staff turnover and a strong track record of looking after and developing their employees.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to take their first step into a career in finance, with full training and support provided.

The Role

As a Junior Purchase Ledger Administrator, you will work alongside an experienced finance team and receive full training across a range of purchase ledger and finance administration duties.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and accurately entering supplier invoices
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery documentation
- Checking supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Assisting with supplier payments and account queries
- Maintaining accurate purchase ledger records
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments
- Assisting with general finance and administration
- Supporting the wider finance team
- Learning and developing your knowledge of accounting systems and processes

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, reliable and keen to learn, with a genuine interest in developing a career within finance.

You don't necessarily need previous purchase ledger experience - attitude and potential are more important. Full training will be provided.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good organisational skills
- Strong communication skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel
- A positive and professional attitude
- The ability to work well as part of a team
- A willingness to learn and develop
- Previous administration, accounts or office experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's In It For You?

This is a great opportunity to join a stable and established manufacturing business that genuinely values its employees.

The company offers:
- Hybrid working
- Bonus scheme
- Full training and ongoing support
- Excellent opportunities for career development
- A supportive and friendly working environment
- Long-term career prospects
- The opportunity to build valuable finance experience
- Excellent employee retention and a low staff turnover

Why This Business?

Having worked with this organisation for many years, we know them to be a great employer with a strong and supportive culture. They offer the stability of an established manufacturing business while still providing opportunities for their employees to develop and progress.

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can learn, build your finance career and become part of a business that values its people, this could be the perfect next step.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Permanent - Full-time - On-Site - Monday-Friday

Shift pattern: 9am - 6pm and 11am - 8pm (swap each week)

Salary: Up to £29,000 per annum + bonus

Have you considered a career in driving recruitment? Do you possess drive, ambition, discipline, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment? If you're passionate about people and delivering exceptional service, this is your opportunity to join the UK's largest recruitment business and build a rewarding career with Staffline.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Recruitment Account Coordinator to support our growing Driving Division, supplying professional drivers to a range of leading transport and logistics client in Barnsley.

This is a fast-moving role where no two days are the same. You'll be responsible for ensuring our clients have access to reliable, compliant, and skilled drivers while delivering a first-class experience to both candidates and customers.

Previous recruitment experience is beneficial but not essential. If you have transferable skills from customer service, transport, logistics, operations, or administration, we'll provide the training and support needed to help you succeed.

What You'll Do as an Account Coordinator

This role is all about building relationships, solving problems, and ensuring our driving workforce is fully supported. Your responsibilities will include:
- Planning and coordinating driver shift coverage to ensure client staffing requirements are met, including managing short-notice changes and absences
- Meeting client requirements by sourcing and placing qualified HGV, LGV, and professional drivers
- Recruiting, screening, interviewing, and onboarding driving candidates
- Verifying licences, CPC qualifications, digital tachograph cards, and conducting compliance checks
- Managing driver availability, shift bookings, and rota planning
- Accurately processing payroll data and validating driver hours
- Handling driver queries, absences, holiday requests, and shift changes
- Ensuring compliance with transport legislation, client requirements, and recruitment best practice
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with both clients and drivers
- Proactively addressing staffing challenges and sourcing solutions to meet operational demands
- Supporting out-of-hours requirements when necessary to ensure service continuity

The Skills You'll Develop as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

At Staffline, you'll receive ongoing coaching, development, and support to help you reach your full potential. In this role, you'll develop expertise in:
- Driving and transport recruitment
- Client relationship management
- Workforce planning and resource allocation
- Driver compliance and industry regulations
- Candidate attraction and retention strategies
- Performance management and service delivery
- Problem-solving and operational decision-making

We actively encourage career progression and offer clear development pathways for those looking to advance their careers within recruitment and account management.

What We Need From You

We're committed to helping you succeed, but to thrive in this role you'll need:
- The ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and solve problems effectively
- A customer-focused approach with a genuine passion for people
- Experience within recruitment, transport, logistics, driving operations, or a customer service environment (preferred but not essential)
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- A keen eye for detail, particularly when handling compliance documentation
- A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of challenges
- Confidence working in a fast-paced environment where responsiveness is key
- Most importantly: tenacity, resilience, flexibility, and a positive attitude towards delivering exceptional service

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch!

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.

title: Administrative Assistant
description: We are looking for a reliable part time admin assistant to join our friendly practice team. The hours are 20 hours per week over 5 days. Monday, Wednesday, Friday 9am-1pm, Tuesday & Thursday 1pm-5pm. The role involves providing efficient and professional administrative support within a healthcare environment. Key responsibilities include processing patient referrals, maintaining accurate patient records, managing confidential information, and handling incoming and outgoing communications. Strong organisation, communication, attention to detail and confidentiality are essential for the role. Processing and managing patient referrals accurately and efficiently. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date patient records in accordance with confidentiality and data protection requirements. Liaising with hospitals, community services, healthcare professionals and patients to coordinate information and services. Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence, telephone calls and electronic communications. Handling sensitive and confidential patient information with professionalism and discretion. Providing administrative support to clinicians and the wider healthcare team. Ensuring administrative tasks are completed accurately and within required timescales.

description: Gateway Primary Care are looking to appoint a part-time receptionist / administrator to join our friendly team. This position would suit an hardworking and enthusiastic and caring person who likes to work in a busy patient facing role. Hours are between 8am and 6:30 pm Monday to Friday and we are looking for between 18 and 24 hours per week. Additional hours will be needed occasionally to cover holidays and sickness.
